definitions.explanation: Each and every day; daily. Used to express something that happens or is done on a daily basis. Can function as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}しています。
{毎日|まいにち}の{生活|せいかつ}は{忙|いそが}しいです。
{毎日|まいにち}{同|おな}じ{時間|じかん}に{起|お}きます。
examples.english: I wake up at the same time every day.

notes: Part of a series of {毎|まい}~ words: {毎週|まいしゅう} (every week), {毎月|まいつき} (every month), {毎年|まいとし/まいねん} (every year). When used as an adverb, it typically comes before the verb phrase. The {毎|まい} prefix means 'every' or 'each.'
